::: {#def-list-length}
#### Length of a list

The **length** $\operatorname{len}(L)$ of a list $L$ (@def-list) is defined recursively,
following the two parts of the definition of a list:

$$
\ba
\operatorname{len}(\mathtt{empty}) &= 0,
\\ \operatorname{len}\paren{\operatorname{cons}(x, L)} &= 1 + \operatorname{len}(L).
\ea
$$

:::
